text:
mason.ops: FYI — Hyperlane just pinged: the EU H200 bulk (ship #AWB-EU-9987) is held at customs due to missing refurb paperwork. ETA slide by ~10 days. They offered a split-air option for 10 units (expedite) or keep sea for full batch (~2w delay).

sara.procurement: Ugh. Do we know if those 10 are the ones tagged for Dedicated EU pools?

mason.ops: Looks like 8 of them were earmarked for Dedicated (eu-dedicated-1) and 2 for edge labs. If split-air, vendor says air surcharge ~ $58k. Sea no surcharge but +12–14 days.

engina-rt: What's impact on SLAs? eu-dedicated-1 is driving peak inference for a customer on committed capacity. If we lose 8 cards throughput drops ~30% on that pool. We should consider traffic shift to us-gpu region or enable fallback to quantized variants.

leo-platform: We can failover routes but two things: (1) latency will increase for EU users if routed to US, (2) cost of cross-region egress and added infra. Estimated monthly delta if we shift steady traffic: ~$18k/mo.

procurement-bot: Vendor notes: 10-unit air expedite available with RMA/serial reconciliation required before ship. RMA docs link: https://hyperlane.example.com/rma/flow?id=AWB-EU-9987

mason.ops: Also: vendor flagged 3 DOA units in the initial sample. They want to process them as part of this RMA (RMA#HL-7421). If we accept split-air, they need sign-off on DOA disposition to consolidate paperwork.

sara.procurement: Can procurement push for vendor credit or absorb air cost in exchange for priority next-month allocation? Ask for a price break if we take 20% more next quarter.

engina-rt: Ops question — if we accept split-air, can platform handle staggered arrival without degrading KV-cache hotstarts? We may need to pre-warm nodes. Plan: cordon incoming nodes, `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` and then bring up with `--kubelet-eviction` tuned. Not ideal in the middle of traffic.

leo-platform: Pre-warming timeline is ~4 hours per node to rebuild caches. If we stagger 2/day it should be manageable. For Dedicated critical pool, recommend we reserve 2 loaner GPUs from our US spare pool for 48 hours as buffer.

mason.ops: Action items I propose: 1) Sara, ask vendor for (a) formal credit proposal or (b) reduced air surcharge, and get written ETA for paperwork resolution. 2) Engina/Leo, document failover plan + pre-warm checklist and estimate ops hours. 3) Procurement-bot, log RMA HL-7421 and attach AWB + customs hold reason.

sara.procurement: On it. I'll push for credit and ask if they can cover customs broker fee (~$1.2k) too. Will update by EOD.

engina-rt: I'll draft a pre-warm runbook and quick commands. Rough snippet to pre-warm cache: ```
# on node bootstrap
systemctl start inference-runtime
curl -sS -X POST https://local-embed/prime -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

leo-platform: Also note: if we accept vendor RMA flow, insist on serial manifest scan before handoff. We saw a serial mismatch last quarter that added 3 days. Require photo evidence + manifest checksum.

mason.ops: Good call. Sara — add the serial-manifest requirement to the ask.

procurement-bot: Logged: {"rma": "HL-7421", "awb": "AWB-EU-9987", "status": "customs_hold"} — procurement queue updated.
